title: FORA WBAFile (Web Bot Auth directory)
description: Pure Web Bot Auth directory served at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory. An RFC 7517 JWK Set (keys) plus an optional directory-level revocation_url, with zero FORA-specific fields. Wire shape is protojson of fora.v1.WBAFile with UseProtoNames=true (snake_case fields).

keys.$comment: Applies to the directories this deployment serves, which its producers validate against this schema: a directory holds only a handful of keys (rotation overlaps a few), so a large keys[] is malformed. A directory this deployment reads is read the way the protocol SDK reads it, with the body capped at 1 MiB and only the keys that signed the response kept.
